<script setup lang="ts">
import Products from "./Products.vue";

const props = defineProps<{
  locale: string,
  uiStyles: {
    buy: {
      title: string,
      icon: string,
      color: string,
      variant: "outlined" | "plain" | "text" | "tonal" | "flat",
      rounded: boolean,
      modal: {
        title: string,
        unitPriceTitle: string,
        selectQuantityTitle: string,
        totalPriceTitle: string,
        icon: string,
        color: string,
        variant: "outlined" | "plain" | "text" | "tonal" | "flat",
        rounded: boolean,
      }
    },
    details: {
      title: string,
      icon: string,
      color: string,
      variant: "outlined" | "plain" | "text" | "tonal" | "flat",
      rounded: boolean
    }
  },
  productIds:string
}>()


</script>

<template>
  <v-row style="position: relative;" align="start">
    <Products :selected-category="null" :product-ids="productIds" :locale="locale" :ui-styles="uiStyles"/>
  </v-row>
</template>

<style scoped>

</style>
